case_search_note: Case Information portal (linked from mariposa.courts.ca.gov/online-services/case-information). Must accept Terms of Use; shows only publicly viewable information and is not the official record. Page does not say which case types (criminal/traffic) are included.

courthouses.name: Mariposa County Superior Court — Historic Courthouse
courthouses.note: Only courthouse in the county; hears criminal and traffic. Mailing: PO Box 28. Check the wall calendar for your name and department. Ask the judge at your first appearance for an appointed lawyer.

public_defenders.name: Court-appointed counsel (Mariposa County)
public_defenders.note: Court's Criminal page: if you don't hire a lawyer, ask the judge at your first appearance to appoint one; the court later decides whether you repay any fees.

jails.name: Mariposa County Adult Detention Facility
jails.phone_note: Jail staffed 24/7; lobby 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Fax (209) 966-8415. Mailing PO Box 727.
jails.note: Type II facility. Staff will not release court dates or recommend bail agents. Visiting: one hour/week, non-contact, first come first served, by housing block (A Sun 1–4, B Sat 1–4, C Fri 1–4, D Wed 1–4, E Sun 9–11, F Sat 9–11; Mondays for Administrative Separation). Video visits/messaging through NCIC (www.NCIC.com). Money: lobby kiosk or phone (866) 345-1884. court_ids: nearest criminal courthouse, not confirmed.
jails.todo: Men/women housing not stated on Sheriff pages

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' (linked from insurance.ca.gov CheckAgntBrkr page) — look up any bail agent's license status. Mariposa jail staff will not recommend or refer bail agents. Bail procedure not described on Sheriff pages; call the jail at (209) 966-3616.
